title: Stormhub AORC Extension
description: Extension for STAC Items with AORC data.

require_any_field.$comment: Please list all fields here so that we can force the existence of one of them in other parts of the schemas.

stormhub:statistics.title: Precipitation Accumultation Statistics
stormhub:statistics.description: A collection of statistics computed using accumulated precipitation data (AORC or CONUS404) for a transposed watershed within the transposition domain

normalized_mean.title: Normalized Mean Precipitation
normalized_mean.description: Mean of precipitation accumulation values divided by corresponding ATLAS14 data values for normalization

stormhub:transform.title: Transform
stormhub:transform.description: A 3x3 matrix stored as a flat array of 9 elements in row major order. Since the last row is always 0,0,1 it can be omitted, in which case only 6 elements are recorded. Refers to the transform applied to the original watershed geometry to yield the provided watershed geometry

stormhub:calendar_year_rank.title: Calendar Year Rank
stormhub:calendar_year_rank.description: Calendar year (January 1- December 31) rank of the storm withing the collection based on mean preciptation summed within the watershed over the storm duration

stormhub:collection_rank.title: Collection Rank
stormhub:collection_rank.description: Absolute rank of the storm withing the collection based on mean preciptation summed within the watershed over the storm duration
